svg.aria-label: Upload throughput, one client: higher is better
svg.title: Upload throughput, one client: higher is better
svg.text: Upload throughput, one client: higher is better
One warm client POSTs a body to nginx over each protocol; MB/s is request body megabytes (10^6) per second, every body
checked against the length the server read. In each panel the clients are sorted best first; under it, mimicry against the
best of the other impersonating clients.
net/http, Go's standard client, as the reference
POST 64 KB, one request at a time
mimicry keeps Chrome's 6 connections per host
